entries.name: Great Deku Tree: defeat Gohma
entries.how: Gives Kokiri's Emerald and a Heart Container.

entries.name: Dodongo's Cavern: defeat King Dodongo
entries.how: Gives Goron's Ruby and a Heart Container.

entries.name: Jabu-Jabu's Belly: defeat Barinade
entries.how: Gives Zora's Sapphire and a Heart Container.

entries.name: Pull the Master Sword in the Temple of Time
entries.how: Needs all three Spiritual Stones and the Ocarina of Time. You wake up seven years later as Adult Link.

entries.name: Receive the Light Medallion from Rauru
entries.how: Comes right after you wake up as Adult Link.

entries.name: Forest Temple: defeat Phantom Ganon
entries.how: Gives the Forest Medallion and a Heart Container.

entries.name: Fire Temple: defeat Volvagia
entries.how: Gives the Fire Medallion and a Heart Container.

entries.name: Water Temple: defeat Morpha
entries.how: Gives the Water Medallion and a Heart Container.

entries.name: Shadow Temple: defeat Bongo Bongo
entries.how: Gives the Shadow Medallion and a Heart Container.

entries.name: Spirit Temple: defeat Twinrova
entries.how: Gives the Spirit Medallion and a Heart Container.

entries.name: Receive the Light Arrows from Zelda
Break the barrier around Ganon's Tower: clear the six trials
entries.how: In Ganon's Castle: Forest, Fire, Water, Shadow, Spirit and Light.
